description:
Hushfacebook v0.24.0 targets Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This one has 127 patches and moves to Facebook 588.0.0.42.55. It needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer, so update Manager and grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. Every patch now goes in on the Android 9 and 10 build too. The next reel can play in the background, groups can keep the tab bar, and a tap on a feed video can bring up a pause button instead of opening Reels. Stories can drop their reply bar and Up next card, Facebook can go through a proxy you name, and a tablet can keep the feed in a column down the middle. Reels fit a tablet held sideways now, and `Play saved videos in a row` no longer stops on a saved post.

Validation: 6101 runtime tests passed locally. All 1739 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 127 patches applied to Facebook 588.0.0.42.55, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 588.0.0.42.55, build 707615136, or its 32-bit build 707615135. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Added

* `Next reel in the background` under Video and audio, for use with `Keep playing in the background`. When a reel playing in the background ends, the next reel Reels had loaded plays instead of the same one again, and you come back to Facebook on the last one played. Facebook doesn't load more reels while it's in the background, so once those run out the last one plays again. It starts off. (#524)
* `Keep the tab bar in groups` in the tab bar settings. Facebook opens a group on a page of its own with no tab bar, so the only way to another tab was Back. With this on, a group keeps the tab bar along the bottom, and tapping a tab takes you straight there. It works while the tab bar is at the bottom and starts off. (#503)
* `Show reactions on the Like button` under News feed moves a post's reaction icons from the far end of the row under it onto the Like button, right before the count, the way the summary line used to read. The button still likes and reacts like before. A video that shows its views there gets one Like icon, or your own reaction once you react. It starts off, and `Hide the reaction preview on posts` wins when both are on. (#541)
* `Tap shows a pause button on feed videos` under Video and audio stops a tap from opening a feed video in Reels. The tap brings up a big play/pause button in the middle of the video and the video keeps playing. Tap the button to pause or play, or tap the video again while it shows to open it. It starts off, and with Tap to play on it needs Inline feed video controls on too. (#538)
* `Hide the live video comment bar` under Comments and writing takes the comment box and the row of reactions off the bottom of a live video, so a stray tap won't send a reaction or open the keyboard. The live comments stay. It starts off. (#537)
* `Ignore taps beside the buttons` under News feed keeps a tap on the empty part of the row under a post, between the buttons and the reaction icons, from opening the comments or who reacted. Handy when you're aiming for a video's seek bar just above. It starts off. (#540)
* `Hide the Follow button` under Stories takes Follow off the top of a story from someone you don't follow. It starts off. (#543)
* `Hide the reply bar` under Stories takes the bar off the bottom of other people's stories, so the repost button, the Send message box and the quick reactions can't be tapped by accident. It starts off. (#542)
* `Hide the Up next card` under Stories starts the next stories right away, without the Up next card counting down over the first one. It starts off. (#544)
* New `Drag along the bottom edge` under Video and audio, for `Thin line seek bar`. While you drag the thin line it stays on the video's bottom edge, a bit thicker, with the time in the middle above it, instead of rising into the full bar. It starts off. (#539)
* `Hide posts with words you choose` and `Hide link posts` each have a switch for every place they reach (Home, the Reels tab, groups, profiles and Pages, and now search results). The first four start on, so nothing changes until you turn one off, and then that place keeps its posts while the others still lose theirs. Search results start off, since you usually want to see what you searched for. Turn it on and the posts on the Posts tab and in All go by your words or links too. (#458)
* `Ask before reacting to a story` under Stories makes a tap on a reaction at the bottom of a story ask "React to this story?" first. The story pauses while the question is up, and only Continue sends the reaction. Cancel, Back or a tap outside sends nothing and the story plays on. It's part of `Ask before a like` and starts off. (#502)
* `Hide friends' reactions on photos and videos` under News feed takes away the little picture of a friend with their reaction on it that Facebook puts in the corner of a photo or video someone you know reacted to. It's off until you turn it on. (#483)
* `Hide who reacted under posts` under News feed takes away the line under a post that names a friend or Page who reacted, like "Name and others reacted". It's off until you turn it on. (#483)
* `In-app proxy` under Privacy sends Facebook's connections through an HTTP proxy you name, like `127.0.0.1:10808`. A VLESS or V2Ray app's local port works there (v2rayNG's is `127.0.0.1:10808`), so Facebook can go through VLESS without the whole phone on a VPN. Leave it blank and Facebook connects the way your phone does. [Help](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/help.md#facebook-through-vless-or-another-proxy) walks through setting it up. (#504)
* `Ask before downloading` under Downloads puts a Continue or Cancel question in front of a reel's Download button, the Download button under a post and a video's `Download to phone`. It starts off. (#511)
* `Emoji font file` under Appearance lets you pick your own .ttf or .otf emoji font for `Use the phone's emoji`. Facebook needs a restart to pick it up, and a font with no emoji in it gets refused. (#513)
* A video opened from a post with several photos or videos now has `Download to phone` in the three-dot menu at the top. (#509)
* `Back to Clean mode` under Reels and Watch puts a reel back in Clean mode by itself after you bring its buttons back. Pick when: once the comments or a menu you opened close, or after 3, 5 or 10 seconds without touching the screen. It starts on Never. (#519)
* `Hide the line along the tab bar` under Tabs and navigation takes away the thin line Facebook draws along the edge of the tab bar, on every tab. It starts off, and a change shows on the next tab you tap. (#521)
* `Plain slide between people` under Stories turns the cube Facebook plays when you swipe from one person's stories to the next into a flat slide. Facebook only uses the cube on some accounts, and others already get a plain slide or a tilt. It's part of `Clean up the story viewer` and starts off. (#521)
* `Header text font` under Appearance picks the font your `Home header text` words draw in. There's Bold (how they've always looked), Regular, Serif, Script and Monospace, and `Your font` uses the font file you picked under `Font file`, even with `Use the system font` off. Facebook draws the header once, so a change shows after a restart. (#532)
* `Hide New for you on reels` under Reels and Watch takes "New for you", and the other reasons Facebook gives for showing you a reel, off the line under its author. It's part of `Clean up Reels` and starts off. With the label kept and `Show the post date on reels` on, the date now shows first, so you don't wait for the line to turn over to see when the reel was posted. (#520)
* `Translate every comment` under Comments and writing shows Facebook's translation on comments in another language as they load, the same as tapping See translation on each one. It comes with `Turn off auto-translation` and starts off. (#522)
* `Long press to save Marketplace photos` under Downloads saves a Marketplace listing's photo when you hold your finger on it, in the listing or opened full screen. It lands in the same folder as every other photo you save. It needs `Save any photo` and starts off. (#515)
* With `See-through bars` on, the strip behind the clock and battery icons is frosted glass too on Android 12 and newer, so the glass runs from the top bar up to the edge of the screen instead of stopping under a solid band. (#507)
* `Dim to` under Reels and Watch picks how much of a reel's buttons, caption and bars still shows once `Burn-in guard` dims them, from 0 to 100 percent. Left blank it stays at the 25 it always used. `Smooth fade` next to it eases them out and back in instead of switching at once, and it starts off. (#523)
* A crash deep in Facebook's native code or a freeze now leaves a `crash-` file in Download/Hushfacebook too, and so does Android 17 closing Facebook for using too much memory. Facebook writes it the next time it starts, even when that start runs paused, with what closed it and Android's own note about it. A freeze keeps the main thread's part of Android's trace. One from before your last update or reinstall says when that was and marks the versions unknown, since they could be the old build's. Before, only a Java crash got a file. (#528)
* `Video buffer` under Video and audio picks how much of a video loads before it starts and while it plays. Low starts a video once half a second has loaded and keeps less loaded ahead, so it uses less data. Medium waits for 1.5 seconds and Maximum for 3, and both keep more loaded ahead (up to a minute on Maximum), which can help when the connection is slow. It starts at Facebook's choice, which leaves everything as Facebook has it, and a change shows on the video that's playing within a moment. (#526)
* `Recently watched in the Menu` under Menu adds a Recently watched row to Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu, right after Watch history. Tap it and the list `Remember what you watch` keeps opens over the Menu, so you don't have to go through the settings to get back to a reel or video. It needs `Resume long videos` and starts off. (#529)
* `Center the feed on big screens` under Appearance keeps the feed and Facebook's other lists in a column down the middle on a tablet or an unfolded phone, so posts stop stretching from one edge of the screen to the other. Reels still get the whole screen. It starts off. (#531)
* Four new switches for the top of a post, all off until you turn them on. `Show full names` under News feed lets a long name wrap onto a second line instead of ending in "...". `Hide songs under names` leaves the song out of the line under the name, with no gap where it was, and `Bold post times` makes the time or date there bold like the name. `Dark box behind feed video names` under Reels and Watch puts a name drawn on top of a feed video on the same dark box reel names can get. (#533)

### Changed

* Hushfacebook now patches Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 and no longer takes 587. On a 64-bit phone download the (arm64-v8a) (120-480dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615136, and on a 32-bit phone the (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615135. Update Facebook before you patch.
* You need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer now, since the patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0 and older Managers turn the bundle down. Update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.
* **Tooling:** The GitHub release notes leave out the Tooling bullets and the What was checked paragraph. How to update opens with the Facebook build the release targets, which is the sentence the in-app update check reads.
* The README is about half as long. The patch list moved to [docs/patches.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/patches.md) and the help topics to [docs/help.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/help.md), and the README links to each topic.
* The changelog starts at 0.20.0 now, so Morphe Manager has a lot less to download when it shows what changed. Versions 0.1.0 to 0.19.0 are in the [changelog archive](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/changelog-archive.md), word for word.
* `Hide create story cards` under Stories now also takes out the full screen "continue the story" card, the one asking you to share a recent moment from your gallery with a Create story button. (#521)
* With `Clean mode button on reels` on, Facebook's button for leaving Clean mode now sits right where the sidebar's Clean mode button was, so the same spot turns it on and off. It takes that spot from your last tap on the sidebar button in that viewer. (#391)
* `Hold a feed photo to react` and `Hold a feed video to react` open the reactions right by your finger now, instead of down by the Like button, so there's no long slide to reach one. Once you let go, a tap anywhere off them closes them without reacting. Their `Reaction` list has a new `Slide to pick one` too: slide to a reaction and let go, and letting go anywhere else closes them. (#454)
* The bug form now requires the Facebook file you patched. (#528)
* When a Debug report says why Facebook went away last time, it now names Android 17's two new reasons, the memory limiter and an anomaly, instead of showing a bare number. (#528)
* With `Keep playing in the background` on, a reel you swiped to in Reels keeps its sound after you leave Facebook. Before, only a video you'd started with a tap carried on, so a reel you'd swiped to went quiet. Reels playing in the feed or in a story still stop when you leave. (#524)
* **Tooling:** The build moves to Gradle 9.9.2, still pinned by checksum. 9.8.2 sits inside seven Gradle advisories from November, the worst being GHSA-3cfg-jpcr-gfp3, where a version catalog's values could run as code.
* **Tooling:** Guava moves to 33.8.0 and Bouncy Castle to 1.87, and the extension tests run on Robolectric 4.18.1. Guava 33.8.0 fixes GHSA-v5x9-67m3-7m56. Bouncy Castle 1.87 fixes the twelve CVEs its release notes list. Neither one ends up in the patches you install, since both only run while the bundle is built and tested. The release check also lists a Guava inside GHSA-v5x9 now, since that advisory isn't in the public database it asks.
* **Tooling:** gson moves to 2.15.0. It only runs while the patch list is written and the bundle is checked, so nothing you install changes. The patch tests stay on apksig 9.1.1, the version the patcher itself still brings.
* **Tooling:** The patches move off Morphe patcher's `bytecodePatch` and `resourcePatch` builders, which 2.5.0 marks deprecated and a later patcher will drop, to its `patch()`. Patch names, descriptions, defaults and options stay the same, so Manager keeps the patches you picked.
* **Tooling:** The register check that runs before a release now follows an object's class where two code paths meet, the way Android's own verifier does. A hook that hands a View parameter what Android sees as a plain Object now fails on the desktop instead of a phone rejecting the whole class at launch, which is how the cold-start tab bar fix first broke on a phone.

### Fixed

* With the tab bar at the bottom sliding away as you scroll, the tabs come all the way back when you scroll back to the top. After a short scroll near the top they used to stop short and sit over the gesture bar until you scrolled again. With `Tab bar while scrolling` on `Hides while scrolling`, Home also opens at the top after a restart. Facebook moved the feed down a little a few seconds after it opened, which slid both bars away before you'd touched anything.
* On a tablet or an unfolded phone held sideways, the reels you swipe to on the Reels tab fit the screen, with the caption, buttons and seek bar showing. Facebook works the reel's height out for the screen held upright, so turned on its side the bottom of every reel ran off the screen. (#531)
* `Play saved videos in a row` keeps going past a saved post. When the next card in Saved was a post and not a video, the post opened and the run of videos stopped there. Now that post closes again on its own and the card after it plays, and the screen stays black while it does, so you don't see the post flash by. Posts you open yourself stay open. (#404)
* `Play saved videos in a row` doesn't shake anymore when you swipe to the next or previous saved video. Facebook first shows a new video a little lower and smaller, under the status bar, then jumps it up to fill the screen. Opening one video by hand you barely notice it, but the run opens a new one on every swipe. Now the screen stays black for that moment and the video shows once it's in place. (#404)
* `3-dot menu items to hide` takes Interested, Not interested and Your algorithm off a reel's More sheet now. They sit in a card at the top of that sheet that's built apart from the rest, so ticking them only hid them from posts. Your algorithm is the reel's name for a post's Manage your Feed, so the list calls that row `Manage your Feed / Your algorithm`. Three more reel rows read the way the sheet shows them too: `Quality settings`, `Request community note` and `Something went wrong` were "Best guess post", "Other" and "Bug". (#475)
* `Seek bar on feed videos` gets out of the way while comments are open. On a phone with the three navigation buttons it showed just above them, under the comments. (#535)
* `Times on the seek bar` and `Full length on the seek bar` work with `Thin line seek bar` now. The times sit just above the line's two ends, whether you're dragging or not. Before, the thin line turned them off. (#487)
* `Hide prompts and promos under reels` also takes the "Made with Edits" pill off the corner of a video in your feed now. That pill is a different piece from the line under a reel's caption, so the switch only caught the line. (#314)
* With `Tap the bar to seek` on, the three dots and other buttons that sit just above a reel's progress line open again. Before, a tap on the bottom of the three dots in a saved reel jumped the video instead of opening the menu. A tap on the line itself still seeks.
* A saved reel you open from your library on the Reels tab fits the screen again. Its bottom no longer runs under the comment box, so Facebook's way out of Clear mode is easy to tap.
* With `Show the post date on reels` on, the date under a reel's author stays put. On a reel with a song, the song line no longer scrolls the date out of sight, and on the others the line holds on the date instead of turning over to the location or "New for you" a few seconds later. (#503)
* A Facebook that crashes or gets closed while you're signed out now leaves its `crash-` file too. Before, a start that stayed on the login screen never wrote it. (#528)
* With `Show the post date on reels` on, a reel shows its date once. Facebook is trying out a second date at the end of the caption on some accounts, and that one now stays out while the date under the author shows. (#503)
* With `Keep playing in the background` on, a video playing in the picture-in-picture window keeps its sound when you lock the phone and plays on in the window when you unlock it. (#495)
* With `Open comments at` on `Full height` or `Half height`, Comment on the Reels tab now slides the regular sheet straight up over the reel. Before, the reel shrank into the top of the screen first, the way Facebook's split view opens, and at full height the sheet covered it a moment later. (#501)
* With the tab bar at the bottom and `See-through bars` or `Rounded tab bar` on, a reel's video now runs the whole screen, down under the tab bar and the gesture bar. Its name, caption and buttons sit above the tab bar instead of behind it and move with the reel as you swipe. (#503, #466)
* With the tab bar at the bottom and `See-through bars` on, the Reels tab now runs the reel up behind the status bar too, so the time and battery sit over the video instead of a solid strip. The Reels title and its buttons stay just below the status bar. (#466)
* With `See-through bars` and `Hide the video comment box` on, a reel or video you open from a post runs down under the gesture bar too, instead of stopping above a dark band. Its caption, its buttons, the seek bar and the Up next card sit just above the gesture bar. (#466)
* With the tab bar at the top and `See-through bars` on, the Reels seek bar now sits just above the gesture bar instead of on it, so dragging it doesn't take you to the home screen. (#466)
* `Fold long text` now holds to the number of lines you picked on posts it used to miss, including the first ones in the feed. Comments fold by how they actually wrap on your screen, so 8 lines means 8 lines, with See more on the last of them instead of a line further down. A video's caption follows the count you picked for posts. (#506)
* The download button under a post and the post's menu now find videos that sit behind a photo or inside an album. A post with several videos gets `Save all videos`. (#509)
* Your own story stays first in the tray when `Move seen stories to the end` or a similar switch is on. (#510)
* The progress line on a reel opened from the feed sits above the gesture bar instead of under it. (#469)
* `Hide the tab bar on the Reels tab` no longer leaves a grey line under the Reels title when your tabs are at the top. The line comes back with the bar on the other tabs. (#508)
* `Seek bar on feed videos` stays out of Facebook's own video viewer, so a video you open from the feed only shows Facebook's bar. (#505)
* A long press on a reel's Download, Cast or Clean mode button no longer opens an empty gray box. (#518)
* With `Hide the tab bar on the Reels tab` on, a reel's time, caption and seek bar sit above the gesture bar again, so the seek bar can be tapped and held. (#516)
* With `Tap to play` on, video stories play by themselves again, the way Facebook plays them. Before, the story after the first one, or one you swiped to, could sit frozen at the start, since a tap on a story moves on instead of playing it. Stories that wait for you are what `Video stories wait for a tap` is for. (#521)
* A Threads post in your feed opens that post in Threads instead of the Threads home feed. The 0.23.0 fix missed the redirect link Facebook now sends the card through, which Threads opens on the feed, and Threads' list form of the post number. Both open the post now. (#385)
* With `View stories anonymously` on, a story you watch counts as watched on your phone again, so its ring turns gray and `Hide seen stories` can take it out. Hushfacebook read the wrong flag on the viewer and took every story for a quick peek, so none of them were kept as watched. (#165, #514)
* `Show the post date on reels` now dates a video posted in a group too. Facebook's full screen viewer gives a group's video no date line under its author, so the date goes after the poster's name, like "Ana Lima · 3 weeks ago". (#520)
* With `Hide posts you've already seen` or another switch that hides a lot of the feed, Home fills in by itself when you open Facebook fresh. When the first pages were all posts the switch hides, Home sat on stories, the Reels shelf and its loading row until you swiped, since Facebook only asks for more posts as the feed scrolls. It now asks again on its own a few times, and a swipe still asks too. (#493)
* With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a video you tap after it played for a while in the feed opens alone too. Facebook had already loaded it by then, so the first batch it handed the viewer held only the videos after yours, and the 0.23.0 trim let one of them through. That batch is skipped now. (#457)
* On Android 17, Facebook getting closed for using too much memory in its first minute now counts toward safe mode the way a crash or a freeze does, so three starts in a row that end like that open Facebook with Hushfacebook paused. It only counts while you're using Facebook. A swipe away, a force stop or Android clearing it out in the background still doesn't. (#528)
* Every patch goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build of 588 (build 707615023) once Hush Unpacker has unpacked it. With 0.23.0 a number of them failed there and had to be unchecked before patching. The README names the bundle to take on Android 9 and 10. (#102, #422)

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Cards and menus stay a shade lighter than the page. Turn on Black cards in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance to make them black too, and Lines between posts there for a thin gray line between posts in the feed. Light background color there gives light mode a soft color in place of white. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

options.description: The color dark mode's backgrounds use, as a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117. Leave it blank for black. Cards and inputs get a slightly lighter shade. Grays up to about #535353 work, and lighter colors are refused so text stays readable.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Facebook's blue on links, buttons, switches and the selected tab for a color you like better. Nothing changes until you pick one. Pick a color in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on the pages where Facebook blocks them, so you can keep a copy of what's on screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Ask before a like
patches.description: Switches that make a tap on Like under a post, beside a reel or under a comment, on Follow in a post or beside a reel, or on a reaction at the bottom of a story, ask first, and only Continue goes ahead, so a stray tap doesn't like, follow or react. The story waits while the question is up. All six start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, Reels and Watch, Stories, and Comments and writing.

patches.name: Badge and logo colors
patches.description: Paints the count badges on the tabs, the Facebook logo at the top of Home and the selected tab in colors you pick. Nothing changes until you type a color. Set them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches.description: Games you play inside Facebook show no ads, so you can keep playing without breaks. A rewarded ad gives no reward unless you also turn on the switch that counts it as watched. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install after seeing ads, and stops several of the ways it sends your phone's advertising ID, so less of what you do feeds its ad tracking. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops the jobs Facebook runs in the background to download ads, and the model it ranks them with, before you ever see them. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Facebook within ten minutes, or any time with No time limit on, so you don't lose what you were reading. A second switch, Back leaves Home where it is, stops Back on a scrolled Home from jumping to the top and reloading. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Blocks the kinds of notification you pick, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays, so you get fewer pings you don't care about. Messages, friend requests, comments and login alerts always come through. Starts off. Turn on the kinds you want in Hushfacebook settings > Notifications. That section also has a row that marks every notification read at once.

patches.name: Block screenshot detection
patches.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats and everywhere else, so it can't react to it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Clean up Facebook's chat list
patches.description: Tidies Chats inside Facebook. One switch empties the row of notes and who's active above your chats, and another removes promotional banners like the one asking you to turn on notifications. A third takes the Meta AI button off the search row and the search screen. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards or Meta promos between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Repost, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also keep the Reels tab to accounts you follow, open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, do the same for a reel you open from a link or a chat, keep the Add friend pop-up off a reel someone who isn't your friend sent you, play a feed video again right there when you tap Watch again instead of opening Reels, play a video you tap in Saved in the video player instead of Reels, go on to the next reel in Saved instead of a suggested one, keep reels playing without stopping to ask "Are you still watching?", fill a tall screen with a reel or a full-screen video instead of leaving black bars around it, with a pinch to see one reel whole, take the UP NEXT bar off the bottom of a video you open from the feed, hide the Fullscreen button under a wide video or the full-screen and picture-in-picture buttons on videos in the feed and search results, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, put Like, Comment, Share and Save back beside long videos, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open and of the Reels tab, and show when a reel or video was posted, or take "New for you" off the line under a reel's author. Its Burn-in guard can fade a reel's buttons, caption and bars when you leave them alone, so they don't burn into the screen. With Turn off HDR brightness patched too, it can show Reels in gray, video and all. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Clean up the story viewer
patches.description: Switches that take the song and effect credits and the Subscribe and Follow buttons off a story, the suggested replies or the whole reply bar off the bottom, the Up next card off the next people's stories, and the cards between stories that ask you to make your own out of the viewer. Two more add a thin progress bar along the bottom like the one on Reels and swap the cube turn between people's stories for a plain slide. Another puts how long ago a story was posted next to the name on stories that leave it out, like a Page's. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Clone install under another package name
patches.description: Installs a second copy of Facebook beside the first under its own package name and app name, for a phone where Facebook came preinstalled and a patched one won't install over it. Hushfacebook settings open in the copy the same way. It isn't selected by default because push notifications may not reach the copy, and you only need it for a second Facebook. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The copy's unique app ID, like com.facebook.katana.hush. Use words joined by dots, each starting with a letter. It can't match Facebook or another Meta app.
The name shown under the copy's home screen icon. Up to 40 characters, starting with a letter or number.

patches.name: Comment sheet options
patches.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, close an open reply thread with a Hide replies button, open more replies with a tap anywhere on their row, hide the comments under feed posts, hide the thumbs-down on comments or turn it into a Block button, put Block on reaction lists, hide Like on comments, hide Reply on comments, hide badges like Top fan on comments, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, show only the comments a search matches, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, keep every reaction beside a comment's count, hide the emoji row over the comment box, hide the line over the comment box, hide the comment box under full-screen videos, and hide the comment box and reactions along the bottom of live videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Default comment order
patches.description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest, All comments or Oldest, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of what Facebook picks. Lower saves data, higher looks sharper. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a quality in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone. Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates, which a patched app can't take anyway. It isn't selected by default because once it's installed, a build without it can't install over it. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Don't save search history
patches.description: Stops Facebook from adding what you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, to your search history, so there's nothing to clear by hand. Searches already there stay until you delete them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops sending Facebook the reels and videos you've watched, where you stopped in a video and how long you watched it, so they stay out of Videos you've watched in your activity log and Facebook learns less about what you watch. Videos you've already seen may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Double tap to skip
patches.description: A double tap on the left or right edge of a reel or video skips back or forward 10 seconds, or 5 on one under 30 seconds. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch. Hide the skip seconds there, also off, keeps the +5s or -10s off the screen while the skip still works.

patches.name: Download any photo
patches.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. A long press on a comment with a photo or GIF in it offers Save photo or Save GIF. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel and a Download row to its More menu, so you can keep reels on your phone. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. The More menu also gets Copy caption, which copies the reel's whole caption. On by default. Turn either off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music, so you can keep the ones you like. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed, in Watch and in the photo and video viewer, so you can save them to watch later. A post with several videos gets Save all videos. A video comment gets Save video when you long-press it. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Fold long text
patches.description: Lets you pick how many lines a long post or comment shows before See more, from 1 to 20, so you can fold sooner or read more before tapping. Starts at Facebook's choice. Pick the lines for posts in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, and for comments under Comments and writing. Reel captions get a count of their own under Reels and Watch. While Show full post text is on, posts still show whole.

patches.name: Following feed on Home
patches.description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, asks Facebook for one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages) instead. When that filter has nothing new, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, so pair it with Hide "Suggested for you" posts and Hide Reels in the feed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says. Useful on tablets, where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Frame step
patches.description: With a reel or video paused, a tap on its right side steps one frame forward and a tap on its left side one frame back, so you can stop on the exact moment you want. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: For phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Facebook asks microG-RE for its push notifications, and microG-RE gets the signature of Meta's own Facebook for the Google services that check one. Install microG-RE first. It isn't selected by default because Facebook then stops asking Google Play services, so on a phone without microG-RE push notifications stop and Google shows a notice asking you to get Play services. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches.description: Removes posts and reels Facebook marked as made with AI, posts creators labeled as AI, posts with Meta's AI characters and Meta AI cards in the feed. Only the Meta AI cards switch starts on. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections and the Muse card in Facebook's Menu, so the Menu has fewer ads for Meta's products. Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu. Switches there, off by default, also hide the Meta AI shortcut, the Your shortcuts row, the Create Facebook Page row or the whole Help and support section and keep Settings and privacy open, and a list there hides the Menu tiles and Help and Settings rows you pick, such as Gaming or Orders and payments.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries
patches.description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts, so you read what people actually wrote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and Ask Meta AI prompts from search results, and stops suggestions from sending your search to Meta AI. You get plain results for people, groups, Pages and posts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts, for a cleaner feed. The post and its buttons stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide Meta upsells
patches.description: Hides Meta's pushes for its other products, such as Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine, so you see fewer sales pitches. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Meta's other products.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends, so the feed sticks to posts. A reel a friend posts stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide Stories tray
patches.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the feed, the stories between posts, or the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home, so you reach posts sooner. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches.description: Removes the shopping cards that affiliate links add to reels, feed posts and comments, plus Shop now cards on reels and the shop banner on a profile you open from one, so you see fewer sales pitches while you scroll. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide carrier data banners
patches.description: On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar with its buy mobile data button, or the purple Free mode bar, so the feed gets that space back. Both switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Hide post prompts
patches.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Ten more switches there, Hide the Follow link on posts, Hide the Subscribe link on posts, Hide the Join button on posts, Hide the X on posts, Hide counts on posts, Hide the reaction preview on posts, Show reactions on the Like button, Hide friends' reactions on photos and videos, Hide who reacted under posts and Show Comment on posts with comments off, start off.

patches.name: Hide posts by words
patches.description: Hides feed posts with words you list, or from people, Pages, groups or sites you list, so you skip topics you're tired of. Photo, video, link and colored background posts, every post a Page wrote, or posts in languages you don't read can go too. Your words and link posts also work on profiles, Pages and in groups, and in search results once you turn that on. On the Reels tab they go by each reel's caption, and so do other languages. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide profile notes
patches.description: Hides the note bubble on profile pictures, the Drop a thought prompt on your own profile included. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide profile pictures
patches.description: Switches that take the profile picture off the top of posts and off comments, so the name starts where the picture was. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Comments and writing.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: People you chat with in chats that open inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages, so you can read now and reply later. Replying may still show you've read it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt and the survey between reels asking how well a video matches your interests, so reels play without the interruption. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide seen posts
patches.description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7, 30 or 90 days, so you see something new. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches.description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results, so you see more of what people are selling. Listings people post stay. It also reads rules typed into Marketplace search: "word" keeps titles with the word, -word hides titles with it and in:place keeps listings in that place, and an Adv. Filters button writes them for you. The search rules and the button are off until you turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind, so you see fewer ads. It also keeps the floating ad button off an ad's comments. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches.description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page, so you only see what they posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and ads in the middle of videos, so you can watch without interruptions. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, so you see the people, Pages and posts you searched for. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories shows only what people posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide story rings
patches.description: Switches that take the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures at the top of posts, next to comments and on profiles, one for each. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads, like "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know" and suggested groups, so you see more from people you follow. Most of its switches are on by default. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, and the "Find friends from contacts" card, so the Stories tray sticks to people you know. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories, where more switches, all off at first, also hide the Create story tile, the Pages you follow and the stories you've already watched, keep only the ones you've watched, or move the ones you've watched to the end.

patches.name: Hide tab badges
patches.description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon, so the app nags you less. Notifications still arrive and still show in the Notifications tab. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation.

patches.name: Hide tabs
patches.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar, such as Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events, so the bar only has what you use, and puts the ones left in the order you want. Each page stays in the Menu. Starts off. Pick the tabs and their order in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens straight on posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats when Messenger is already installed. A patched Facebook may not see that Messenger is there, so it keeps showing the card. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, off the tab bar, so Reels isn't one tap away. Reels in your feed and reel links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, so it stops calling for your attention. Other tabs keep theirs. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes, so you can write without anyone watching. Your messages send as usual. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. A second switch does the same for videos playing in the feed and in Watch, and a third keeps the plain 2x pill without Facebook's "Pull down to lock 2x speed" hint. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches.description: Stops Facebook sending its usage reports in the background and skips the learning jobs it runs on your phone, so less about how you use the app leaves it. A second switch holds back the camera roll processing that uploads your photos and details about them for sharing suggestions. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Home header text
patches.description: Shows your own words or picture at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo. Words take Facebook's own colors for light and dark mode. Type them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance > Home header text, or pick a picture under Home header picture. Blank keeps Facebook's logo.

patches.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, so the settings are easy to find. A Saved row joins it while the Saved shortcut switch is on, a Watch history row while the Watch history shortcut switch is, a Recently watched row while Recently watched in the Menu is, and a Free stuff row, Marketplace's free listings, while the Free stuff shortcut switch under Marketplace is. On by default. Turn it off with Settings row in Menu in Hushfacebook settings > Menu, unless it's the last way into the settings still on.

patches.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, the title at the top of another tab, or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon, Icon style can make the icon Hushfacebook's logo, white on black or black on white, and Notification icon puts Hushfacebook's H on notifications. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

options.description: A name to show under the app icon, in App info and in recent apps instead of Facebook, up to 50 characters, so this copy is easy to tell apart. Leave it empty to keep Facebook's name. It only changes the name. Clone app is what lets a copy install next to the official Facebook.

Facebook colors keeps the home screen icon as it is. Hushfacebook draws Hushfacebook's blue H logo instead, so this copy is easy to tell apart from the official app. White on black and Black on white draw Facebook's "f" in one color on a plain icon. Themed icons on Android 13 and up still work.
Facebook keeps Facebook's "f" on notifications and in the status bar. Hushfacebook puts Hushfacebook's H there instead. Icons that show what a notification is about, like a friend request's, stay.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install next to your patched Facebook. Without it, Android refuses them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. It can also keep a long watch of a video you open from turning the feed's sound on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Keep playing in the background
patches.description: A video you started with a tap, or a reel you swiped to in Reels, keeps its sound when you leave Facebook, with Facebook's own notification to pause it. A reel can go on to the next one instead of playing again. A headphones button in the picture-in-picture window does the same for the video in it. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Keep post dates
patches.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name, so you can always tell how old a post is. Facebook's newer header can swap it for rotating details, and on some phones the line goes blank. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. The same page can leave the song out of that line and make the time bold.

patches.name: Keep the progress bar
patches.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: A speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels, even after Facebook restarts, so you don't set it every time. Pick normal speed to go back. On by default. A second switch for feed and Watch videos starts off. Live videos that have ended get Playback speed in their gear menu too, also on by default. Another switch, off to start, puts Playback speed from 0.5x to 3x in a feed or Watch video's three-dot menu. All of it is in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Local profile counts
patches.description: Shows friends, followers and following counts you type yourself on your own profile, on this phone only. Other profiles and Facebook's real numbers aren't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Longer music on photo stories
patches.description: A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. The Events only switch does the same for Events once you pin Events in Facebook's Customize the bar. Both start off. Turn one on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Gives Facebook the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, so it matches your phone. Dark mode takes them everywhere, and light mode on its grays, blues and selected tab. A switch in Hushfacebook's settings turns it off without patching again. It isn't selected by default because it recolors Facebook as soon as it's patched in. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Newest reels first
patches.description: Plays the newest posted of the reels Facebook has loaded for you first in the Reels tab, instead of Facebook's own pick. It can't fetch newer reels. A second switch lists a profile's Reels tab with its most viewed reels first. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing the switch or whether Messenger is installed or enabled, so call routing updates. Open chats in Messenger, another switch that starts off, opens chats in Messenger instead of inside Facebook, the Message button on a profile included.

patches.name: Open comments at full height
patches.description: Opens the comment sheet at full or half height instead of part way up. Full height fills the screen on posts, videos, reels and stories. Half height covers half the screen, and the reel or video keeps playing above it. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet instead of the split view. Other switches pause a reel while its comments are open, let a tap on the reel above a half-open sheet play or pause it, and put a magnifier at the top of the comments that searches them for your words. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Open comments with a gesture
patches.description: Open a reel's comments with a double tap or a long press, on the sheet the Comment button opens, instead of liking or holding, and a feed post's with a long press on its photo or name line. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch. It also lets a long press on a post's text open that text to select part of it, a switch in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Two more switches there make holding a post's photo, or its video, open its reactions or give one reaction you pick.

patches.name: Open in Facebook from the share menu
patches.description: Adds Open in Facebook to Android's share menu. Share a Facebook link or page to it from Messenger's browser or any other app, and it opens here instead of in that app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your own browser instead of Facebook's built-in one, without Facebook tracking the click. Facebook pages still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing. A second switch, on by default under Privacy, stops Facebook's browser keeping a history of the links you open in it. A Page's Events link opens on that Page's Events tab instead of Home, whichever way the switches are set.

patches.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick when you start it from its icon, so you can skip the feed. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Photo carousel
patches.description: Shows a post's photos and videos in a row you swipe through, one at a time with a 4/10 count and dots, instead of a grid. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom
patches.description: Pinch a story, a video in your feed, or a photo on someone's profile or in Photo carousel to zoom in, like you can on other photos in the feed. It goes back when you let go, unless you turn on Stay zoomed under it, which keeps the zoom until you tap or press Back. Keep videos playing while zoomed, another switch under it, lets a video play on while you zoom, stories included, and with Stay zoomed you press and hold to pause it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Post action buttons
patches.description: Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts, and a Download button on posts with a video or photos that saves them the way the post's menu does. It can also take Like, Comment, Share, Send, Save or the Stars and gifts button out of that row, and keep a tap on the row's empty part from opening the comments. Each has its own switch, and they all start off. Find them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Post menu items
patches.description: Lets you hide rows you never use from the three-dot menu of posts and reels, such as Interested, Not interested or Cast, so you can't tap them by accident. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Remove the gap above Marketplace listings
patches.description: Takes out the empty band some phones show between the status bar and a Marketplace listing's close and share buttons, like Pixels on Android 17. Phones without the gap look the same as before. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it, and opens Instagram and Threads links in a patched Instagram or Threads. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Remember what you watch, a second switch, keeps a list on your phone of the reels, videos and stories you watched, under Recently watched. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. It also lets Take breaks count reels for its Also after 20 reels switch.

patches.name: Round stories tray
patches.description: Draws the stories row on Home as round pictures at a size you pick, like Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing.

patches.name: Saved button in search
patches.description: Adds a Saved button at the end of the search bar, so your saved posts and videos are one tap away. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Search date range
patches.description: Adds a from and to date picker to the Date posted filter in post search, in place of the list of years, so you can narrow results to a few days or a stretch of months. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Search posts tab
patches.description: Puts the Posts chip back in the row over search results, after Reels, so you can see only posts for what you searched. A Videos chip can go in next to it too. Turn each on or off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: See who shared
patches.description: Adds See who shared to a post's menu, which opens Facebook's list of the people who shared it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality
patches.description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Share sheet items
patches.description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing, where two switches that start off also take away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat and the row of people Facebook suggests sending to.

patches.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches.description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Show full post text
patches.description: Shows all of a post's text in the feed, and a reel's caption, so you don't have to tap See more. A tap on the text folds it back. Starts off. Turn posts on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, and reel captions under Reels and Watch, where an open or folded caption can also sit on a dark box like subtitles. The names on reels and stories can get the same box, and so can a name drawn over a video in the feed. A long name at the top of a post can wrap onto a second line instead of getting cut off.

patches.name: Skip location prompts
patches.description: Stops Facebook from showing its page asking you to allow Location Services, the one with Skip and Continue that comes up after you sign in. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Skip silent parts
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and stories past the silent stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. With Resume long videos patched too, a video's menu can keep the silent parts in that one video.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop update prompts
patches.description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.

patches.name: Story viewer taps
patches.description: A tap in the middle of a story shows a play and pause button, like Reels, and a second switch makes stories change only on a double tap, so a single tap pauses or plays instead. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. `Tab bar position` can also put it at the top, as older Facebook had it, or leave it where Facebook puts it. `Tab bar while scrolling` lets it slide away as you scroll or keeps it on screen, and another switch keeps the top bar on screen. One gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too, and another keeps the feed in a column down the middle on those big screens. One makes the top bar and the tab bar see-through. Another hides the phone's status bar on the main screen until you swipe down from the top, and another keeps the Reels tab's bars light in light mode, like the other tabs. One hides the tab bar on the Reels tab alone, so the reel gets the whole screen. Three more take the Messenger button, its unread count or the Facebook logo out of the top bar. Starts off. Pick it in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook. The see-through, status bar, centered feed and Reels tab switches sit under Appearance.

patches.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Tap shows the controls
patches.description: A tap on a playing reel shows its controls and lets it keep playing, so you can skip or mute without stopping it. The button in the middle still pauses. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. A separate switch adds a play/pause button to feed videos. The switches start off in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Translate posts
patches.description: Translates posts in another language through Google Translate, from a Translate line under the post or by themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches.description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. A second switch fixes pale, washed-out reels on phones that show them that way. Its switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Turn off auto-translation
patches.description: Shows posts, comments and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a reel, a video or a photo in the feed from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays, pauses or opens the photo, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu, photos and new screens at once, without the slide or zoom between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. A second switch, Use the icon at the top of Home, puts your pick at the top of Home too. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Upload Stories in HD
patches.description: Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard, so they can come out sharper. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, where you can also pick an emoji font file, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Use the system font
patches.description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Video buffer
patches.description: Picks how much of a video loads before it starts and while it plays. Low starts videos sooner and uses less data. Medium and Maximum wait a little longer to start and keep more loaded ahead, which can help on a slow connection. Starts at Facebook's choice. Pick a size in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. Whatever the size, a paused video that's still loading when you leave Facebook stops waking your phone a hundred times a second.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you. Stories you watch to the end show as watched on this phone only, until that person posts a new one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

release_notes:
This one moves to Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 and needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer, so update Manager and grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. Every patch now goes in on the Android 9 and 10 build too. There's a lot new here. The next reel can play in the background, groups can keep the tab bar, and a tap on a feed video can bring up a pause button instead of opening Reels. Stories can lose their reply bar and Up next card, Facebook can go through a proxy you name (handy for VLESS), and a tablet can keep the feed in a column down the middle. On the fix side, reels fit the screen on a tablet held sideways and behind see-through bars, and `Play saved videos in a row` no longer stops on a saved post or shakes between videos. The tab bar also comes all the way back when you scroll to the top, and on Android 17 a close for using too much memory leaves a crash file and counts toward safe mode.

New in this release

- `Next reel in the background` under Video and audio, for use with `Keep playing in the background`. When a reel playing in the background ends, the next reel Reels had loaded plays instead of the same one again, and you come back to Facebook on the last one played. Facebook doesn't load more reels while it's in the background, so once those run out the last one plays again. It starts off. (#524)

- `Keep the tab bar in groups` in the tab bar settings. Facebook opens a group on a page of its own with no tab bar, so the only way to another tab was Back. With this on, a group keeps the tab bar along the bottom, and tapping a tab takes you straight there. It works while the tab bar is at the bottom and starts off. (#503)

- `Show reactions on the Like button` under News feed moves a post's reaction icons from the far end of the row under it onto the Like button, right before the count, the way the summary line used to read. The button still likes and reacts like before. A video that shows its views there gets one Like icon, or your own reaction once you react. It starts off, and `Hide the reaction preview on posts` wins when both are on. (#541)

- `Tap shows a pause button on feed videos` under Video and audio stops a tap from opening a feed video in Reels. The tap brings up a big play/pause button in the middle of the video and the video keeps playing. Tap the button to pause or play, or tap the video again while it shows to open it. It starts off, and with Tap to play on it needs Inline feed video controls on too. (#538)

- `Hide the live video comment bar` under Comments and writing takes the comment box and the row of reactions off the bottom of a live video, so a stray tap won't send a reaction or open the keyboard. The live comments stay. It starts off. (#537)

- `Ignore taps beside the buttons` under News feed keeps a tap on the empty part of the row under a post, between the buttons and the reaction icons, from opening the comments or who reacted. Handy when you're aiming for a video's seek bar just above. It starts off. (#540)

- `Hide the Follow button` under Stories takes Follow off the top of a story from someone you don't follow. It starts off. (#543)

- `Hide the reply bar` under Stories takes the bar off the bottom of other people's stories, so the repost button, the Send message box and the quick reactions can't be tapped by accident. It starts off. (#542)

- `Hide the Up next card` under Stories starts the next stories right away, without the Up next card counting down over the first one. It starts off. (#544)

- New `Drag along the bottom edge` under Video and audio, for `Thin line seek bar`. While you drag the thin line it stays on the video's bottom edge, a bit thicker, with the time in the middle above it, instead of rising into the full bar. It starts off. (#539)

- `Hide posts with words you choose` and `Hide link posts` each have a switch for every place they reach (Home, the Reels tab, groups, profiles and Pages, and now search results). The first four start on, so nothing changes until you turn one off, and then that place keeps its posts while the others still lose theirs. Search results start off, since you usually want to see what you searched for. Turn it on and the posts on the Posts tab and in All go by your words or links too. (#458)

- `Ask before reacting to a story` under Stories makes a tap on a reaction at the bottom of a story ask "React to this story?" first. The story pauses while the question is up, and only Continue sends the reaction. Cancel, Back or a tap outside sends nothing and the story plays on. It's part of `Ask before a like` and starts off. (#502)

- `Hide friends' reactions on photos and videos` under News feed takes away the little picture of a friend with their reaction on it that Facebook puts in the corner of a photo or video someone you know reacted to. It's off until you turn it on. (#483)

- `Hide who reacted under posts` under News feed takes away the line under a post that names a friend or Page who reacted, like "Name and others reacted". It's off until you turn it on. (#483)
